config_path.description: The path to the main LQA configuration file used with -c

log_path.description: The path to the log file used with --log-file

wait_timeout.description: Default timeout in seconds for waiting on submitted jobs (--wait TIMEOUT)

profiles.description: List of profile names or paths to use (--profile PROFILE)

check_image_url.description: Whether to check that image URLs exist before submitting (--check-image-url)
